alreadyPaid.title: Waramaze kwishyura?
alreadyPaid.intro: Ihute. Uko utanga raporo kare, ni ko amahirwe yo guhagarika amafaranga yiyongera. Izi ntambwe zivuye mu nzego zemewe.
alreadyPaid.numberOnSite: Hamagara serivisi y'abakiliya. Koresha nimero iri ku rubuga rwabo rwemewe.

stop.title: Hagarika kwishyura
stop.body: Ntukohereze andi mafaranga, kabone n'iyo bakwizeza kuyagusubiza, bakagutera ubwoba cyangwa bakagusaba amafaranga ya nyuma.

evidence.title: Bika ubutumwa bwose n'inyemezabwishyu
evidence.body: Ntusibe ikiganiro. Bika amafoto y'ubutumwa, nimero za telefoni, amazina, inyemezabwishyu na nimero y'ihererekanya (transaction ID) ya buri bwishyu.

rib.title: Tanga raporo kuri RIB kuri 166
rib.body: Hamagara Urwego rw'Igihugu rw'Ubugenzacyaha ku buntu kuri 166 ubabwire ibyabaye. Zana ibimenyetso byawe.

provider.title: Vugana vuba na sosiyete ya Mobile Money ukoresha
provider.body: Hamagara sosiyete ukoresha ako kanya, ufite nimero y'ihererekanya. Basabe guhagarika cyangwa gusubiza ubwo bwishyu.

assess.title: Subiza ibibazo bike
assess.intro: Nta butumwa ufite bwo gushyiramo? Subiza ibibazo 6 byihuse ku itangazo, Genzura ikwereke urugero rw'ibyago.
assess.question: Ikibazo
assess.error: Ntibyashobotse gusuzuma ibisubizo byawe. Reba interineti yawe wongere ugerageze.
assess.noReasons: Nta gisubizo cyawe cyagaragaje ikimenyetso cy'uburiganya.

admin.intro: Imibare ya none ivuye mu masuzuma yabitswe na Genzura.
admin.signInRequired: Injira ukoresheje konti y'umuyobozi kugira ngo ubone ikibaho.

alerts.title: Akira amakuru y'uburiganya kuri SMS
alerts.intro: Rimwe mu cyumweru tukoherereza SMS ku kimenyetso cy'uburiganya tubona cyane, kugira ngo ukimenye mbere. Ni ubuntu. Subiza STOP igihe icyo ari cyo cyose ngo uhagarike.
alerts.label: Nimero ya telefoni yawe
alerts.consent: Nemeye ko Genzura ibika iyi nimero gusa kugira ngo inyoherereze amakuru y'uburiganya.
alerts.done: Byakozwe. Uri bwakire SMS ikwakira. Subiza STOP ngo uhagarike.
alerts.invalid: Andika nimero ya telefoni yo mu Rwanda yemewe.
alerts.failed: Ntibyashobotse kwiyandikisha ubu. Uzongere ugerageze nyuma.

agencies.title: Iki kigo gifite uruhushya?
agencies.warning: U Rwanda ntiruratanga uruhushya ku kigo na kimwe cyo gushakira abantu akazi mu mahanga. Niba hari ukubwiye ko ari ikigo gifite uruhushya cy'akazi ko hanze, bifate nk'ikimenyetso cy'uburiganya.
agencies.licensed: Iki kigo kiri ku rutonde rwemewe.
agencies.notLicensed: ntikiri ku rutonde urwo ari rwo rwose rwemewe. Nta kigo kirahabwa uruhushya rw'akazi ko hanze.

1.title: Shyiramo itangazo
1.body: Koporora ubutumwa bwa WhatsApp cyangwa imeli, cyangwa ushyireho ifoto yabwo. Hitamo akazi, buruse cyangwa viza.

2.title: Menya urugero rw'ibyago mu masegonda
2.body: Genzura isuzuma itangazo ishakisha ibimenyetso by'uburiganya bizwi, ikakwereka neza ibyo yabonye.

3.title: Irinde
3.body: Ntukishyure utabanje kugenzura. Tanga raporo kuri RIB kuri 166 cyangwa usabe ubufasha Umuhuzabikorwa w'Ikoranabuhanga.

home.signsIntro: Ibimenyetso bikunze kugaragara mu matangazo y'ibinyoma yo hanze. Uko itangazo rifite ibimenyetso byinshi, ni ko ibyago byiyongera.

text.job: BYIHUTIRWA! Akazi ko muri hoteli i Dubai, umushahara wa 2,000,000 RWF ku kwezi. Nta kizamini cy'akazi gikenewe, viza yemejwe 100%. Ishyura amafaranga yo kwiyandikisha 150,000 RWF kuri MTN MoMo mbere yo ku wa Gatanu kugira ngo ubone umwanya. Vugana na hr.dubaijobs@gmail.com cyangwa kuri WhatsApp gusa: +250 78X XXX XXX.
text.scholarship: Turakwishimiye! Watoranyijwe kubona buruse yishyuriwe byose muri Canada. Kugira ngo ubone umwanya wawe, ohereza kopi ya pasiporo yawe kandi wishyure amafaranga y'ibyangombwa 120,000 RWF kuri MTN MoMo bitarenze amasaha 24. Vugana n'umukozi wacu kuri WhatsApp: +250 78X XXX XXX. Imyanya ni mike.
text.visa: Bona viza y'akazi mu Bwongereza mu minsi 7, wizeye ko uzabona viza 100%! Nta kizamini cya IELTS gikenewe. Tanga pasiporo yawe na konti ya banki ku mukozi wacu i Kigali, wishyure amafaranga 300,000 RWF ya viza kuri MTN MoMo uyu munsi gusa. Ihute, ni amahirwe ya nyuma.

channels.intro: Yagenewe telefoni zose, kuva ku zigezweho kugeza ku zisanzwe.

web.title: Urubuga
web.body: Shyiramo ubutumwa cyangwa ifoto yabwo, ubone igisubizo mu masegonda.

ussd.title: USSD
ussd.body: Kanda kode ngufi kuri telefoni iyo ari yo yose, nta interineti ikenewe, ubone igisubizo kuri ekarani.

sms.title: SMS
sms.body: Akira igisubizo mu butumwa bugufi ushobora kubika no kwereka abandi.

1.a: Yego. Gusuzuma itangazo nta kiguzi bisaba.

2.a: Amafoto asomerwa kuri telefoni yawe kandi ntoherezwa ahandi. Inyandiko y'itangazo irasuzumwa ikabikwa nta makuru bwite arimo nka nimero za telefoni cyangwa imeli, kugira ngo inzego zibishinzwe zibone uko uburiganya buhagaze zitamenye uwo uri we.

3.q: Niba igisubizo ari IBYAGO BIKE, itangazo riba ryizewe?
3.a: Si ngombwa. Nta gikoresho gishobora kwizera 100%. IBYAGO BIKE bivuze ko nta bimenyetso bikomeye by'uburiganya byabonetse. Buri gihe banza ugenzure ikigo unyuze ku nzego zemewe mbere yo kwishyura cyangwa gutanga ibyangombwa.

4.a: Amatangazo y'akazi, buruse na viza, cyane cyane ay'amahirwe yo hanze y'igihugu wakiriye kuri WhatsApp, SMS, imeli cyangwa imbuga nkoranyambaga.

5.q: Nta telefoni igezweho mfite. Nshobora kuyikoresha?
5.a: Hari gukorwa uburyo bwa USSD na SMS kuri telefoni zisanzwe, kugira ngo buri wese abashe gusuzuma itangazo nta interineti.

6.a: Hagarika kohereza amafaranga, ubike ubutumwa bwose n'inyemezabwishyu, maze utange raporo ku Rwego rw'Igihugu rw'Ubugenzacyaha (RIB) kuri 166 vuba bishoboka.
